quests.instruction: Which word could describe a great-great-grandchild, several generations from now?
quests.question: Descendants
quests.hint: This word can stretch many generations into the future.
quests.explanation: Descendants could describe a great-great-grandchild, several generations from now.
quests.funFact: Just like you have great-great-grandparents, you might one day have great-great-grandchildren too!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means the invisible thread of love that connects generations of relatives?
quests.question: Family Bond
quests.hint: This phrase describes an emotional connection, not something you can see.
quests.explanation: Family Bond means the invisible thread of love that connects generations of relatives.
quests.funFact: Unlike a physical trait, a family bond cannot be seen, but it can absolutely be felt!

quests.instruction: Which phrase could describe lighting the very same kind of cake candles every birthday?
quests.question: Family Traditions
quests.hint: This phrase is about a repeated custom, not a one-time celebration.
quests.explanation: Family Traditions could describe lighting the very same kind of cake candles every birthday.
quests.funFact: Even small repeated customs, like a favorite candle style, count as meaningful family traditions!

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes similar looks passed down through a family, generation after generation?
quests.question: Family Resemblance
quests.hint: This phrase is about looks passed through generations, not customs.
quests.explanation: Family Resemblance describes similar looks passed down through a family, generation after generation.
quests.funFact: Scientists study genes to understand exactly how family resemblance gets passed down!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means an event planned so extended family can all meet up in one place?
quests.question: Family Reunion
quests.hint: This phrase is about a planned occasion, not the relatives themselves.
quests.explanation: Family Reunion means an event planned so extended family can all meet up in one place.
quests.funFact: Planning a family reunion often takes months of coordinating schedules and travel!

quests.instruction: Which word describes anyone whose family line traces back to a particular ancestor?
quests.question: Descendants
quests.hint: This word connects a person back to someone earlier in their family line.
quests.explanation: Descendants describes anyone whose family line traces back to a particular ancestor.
quests.funFact: A single ancestor from long ago can end up having thousands of descendants over time!

quests.instruction: Which phrase could describe the trust built between siblings who grew up together?
quests.question: Family Bond
quests.hint: This phrase is about trust and closeness, not looks or repeated customs.
quests.explanation: Family Bond could describe the trust built between siblings who grew up together.
quests.funFact: Growing up together often helps siblings build one of the strongest family bonds of all!

quests.instruction: Which phrase could describe a family's yearly camping trip that never gets skipped?
quests.question: Family Traditions
quests.hint: This phrase describes a repeated yearly custom, not a single trip.
quests.explanation: Family Traditions could describe a family's yearly camping trip that never gets skipped.
quests.funFact: Yearly trips are a popular family tradition that many families look forward to all year long!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means the way a niece might have her aunt's exact same curly hair?

quests.hint: This phrase describes a shared physical trait, not a shared custom.
quests.explanation: Family Resemblance means the way a niece might have her aunt's exact same curly hair.
quests.funFact: Hair type, like curly or straight, is one of many traits that can run in a family!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means a planned gathering that brings together a family's many different branches?
quests.question: Family Reunion

quests.explanation: Family Reunion means a planned gathering that brings together a family's many different branches.
quests.funFact: Some big family reunions bring together well over a hundred relatives at once!

quests.instruction: Which word means the future family members who will one day look back at you as an ancestor?
quests.question: Descendants
quests.hint: One day, you will be an ancestor to this exact group.
quests.explanation: Descendants means the future family members who will one day look back at you as an ancestor.

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes the loyalty and care that family members often show one another?
quests.question: Family Bond
quests.hint: This phrase describes caring actions and feelings, not shared looks.
quests.explanation: Family Bond describes the loyalty and care that family members often show one another.
quests.funFact: Showing up for each other during tough times is one way family bonds grow stronger!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means activities, like a favorite holiday meal, that a family does again and again?
quests.question: Family Traditions
quests.hint: This phrase is about repeated habits, not the food itself.
quests.explanation: Family Traditions means activities, like a favorite holiday meal, that a family does again and again.
quests.funFact: Favorite holiday recipes are one of the most common family traditions passed down through generations!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means shared physical traits, like a dimple or freckles, seen across a family?
quests.question: Family Resemblance
quests.hint: This phrase is about visible physical traits specifically.
quests.explanation: Family Resemblance means shared physical traits, like a dimple or freckles, seen across a family.
quests.funFact: Small physical traits, like a single dimple, can be passed down through many generations!

quests.instruction: Which phrase could describe cousins, aunts, uncles, and grandparents all meeting at once?
quests.question: Family Reunion
quests.hint: This phrase describes the occasion where all these relatives gather.
quests.explanation: Family Reunion could describe cousins, aunts, uncles, and grandparents all meeting at once.
quests.funFact: Big family reunions sometimes need name tags to help everyone remember who is who!

quests.instruction: Which word could describe your own children and grandchildren, not yet born?
quests.question: Descendants
quests.hint: This word can include family members who have not been born yet.
quests.explanation: Descendants could describe your own children and grandchildren, even those not yet born.
quests.funFact: You are already someone's descendant, even before you have any descendants of your own!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means the special connection that makes family feel different from strangers?

quests.hint: This phrase is about an emotional connection, not physical looks.
quests.explanation: Family Bond means the special connection that makes family feel different from strangers.
quests.funFact: Family bonds often form the very first close relationships a person experiences in life!

quests.instruction: Which phrase means the unique habits and celebrations that make one family different from another?

quests.explanation: Family Traditions means the unique habits and celebrations that make one family different from another.

quests.explanation: Family Resemblance could explain why two cousins are sometimes mistaken for siblings.

quests.instruction: Which phrase means an event where family members catch up after being apart for a while?
quests.question: Family Reunion
quests.hint: This phrase describes catching up, not just living together.
quests.explanation: Family Reunion means an event where family members catch up after being apart for a while.
quests.funFact: Catching up on each other's news is one of the best parts of any family reunion!

quests.instruction: Which word describes the people found at the very bottom of a family tree, in the newest generations?

quests.explanation: Descendants describes the people found at the very bottom of a family tree, in the newest generations.

quests.instruction: Which phrase could describe a family recipe passed down from a grandmother?

quests.explanation: Family Traditions could describe a family recipe passed down from a grandmother.

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes when family members look alike, like sharing the same nose or smile?

quests.instruction: Which phrase describes a party specifically organized to bring together a whole extended family?
quests.question: Family Reunion

quests.instruction: Which word means being related to someone through being born after them, not before?
